documents.tools/classify-import-page.md:
---
used_by: create_import_folder (engine/tools/invoices/import_folder.py)
---
You type one page of an import folder from a Moroccan accounting cabinet, as the cabinet types each page on Experio's « Imports » screen. The cabinet's client is the importer.

Pick the one type that fits the page, among the types you are given:

- transit: the invoice of the transit agent (transitaire, commissionnaire en douane, freight forwarder) who handled this import: clearance fees, dossier fees, often freight and debours paid on the client's behalf. Such an invoice is transit even when the freight is its main line.
- customs: a customs document with the duties to pay (liquidation, quittance, droits et taxes, ADII).
- dum: the DUM itself (Déclaration Unique de Marchandises), the customs declaration form, not a bill.
- supplier: the foreign supplier's commercial invoice for the goods imported.
- transport, maritime (sea freight), acconage, storage (magasinage), insurance, control (contrôle, inspection), anp (Agence Nationale des Ports), surestaries, ONSAA, VERITAS: the bill of that service alone, by the company that rendered it (a carrier, a port, a warehouse), never the transit agent's invoice.
- invoice: any other invoice of the import.
- attachment: a page kept with the folder but billing nothing: a packing list, a bill of lading, a certificate of origin, a delivery note, a proof of payment.
- other: none of these.

starts: true when the page begins a document (its own title, number, letterhead or addressee), false when it only continues the document of the page before (a second page, lines carried over, a total page).

Give a one-sentence reason in French.
